reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Default exception settings: the Helm chart values of the prior versions enabled exceptions by default for all namespaces", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Policy exceptions are no longer enabled by default in all namespaces. Users who relied on that will see exceptions stop applying outside the namespaces they configure.
consequence.remediation: Explicitly configure the namespaces where policy exceptions should be enabled.

proposed.statement: The chart's default no longer enables policy exceptions in all namespaces (CVE-2024-48921), so users who relied on exceptions in all namespaces are affected.
